vocab.meaning_vi: hướng dẫn từng bước cho bạn

vocab.example_vi: Để tôi hướng dẫn bạn từng bước qua các tính năng chính của nền tảng.

vocab.meaning_vi: vấn đề, nỗi đau của khách hàng

vocab.example: Customization is easy—you can change the dashboard layout anytime.

vocab.meaning_vi: quy trình khởi tạo, làm quen với sản phẩm

lines.speaker: Vy (sales rep)
lines.text: Thanks for joining, Mr. Tan. Let me take you through our platform.

lines.speaker: Vy (sales rep)
lines.text: Here's a real-world example that matches your industry: automated reporting.

lines.speaker: Tan (client)
lines.text: That looks useful. Does it solve manual data entry?

lines.speaker: Vy (sales rep)
lines.text: Exactly, that's the main pain point our tool solves.

lines.speaker: Tan (client)
lines.text: Can we customize the dashboard for our team?

lines.speaker: Vy (sales rep)
lines.text: Yes, customization is easy and takes just a few clicks.

lines.speaker: Tan (client)
lines.text: Good. What about connecting it to our current systems?

lines.speaker: Vy (sales rep)
lines.text: We offer seamless integration with most CRM tools.

lines.speaker: Tan (client)
lines.text: Great, feel free to continue, I'll follow along.

lines.speaker: Vy (sales rep)
lines.text: Our onboarding process takes less than a week too.

lines.speaker: Tan (client)
lines.text: That's fast. What's the action plan from here?
